main.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
main.subtitle: The Level Can Change Its Mind
main.summary: Super Mario Bros. Wonder is Nintendo's 2023 Switch platform game, built around Wonder Flowers that transform its courses.

cards.heading: The Level Can Change Its Mind
cards.text: Super Mario Bros. Wonder is Nintendo's 2023 side-scrolling platform game for Switch, released on October 20. Its Wonder Flowers transform familiar parts of a course, changing geometry, rhythm and behaviour. Badges modify character abilities, while local and online multiplayer give players different ways to share the adventure. Nintendo built these surprises around familiar controls so that players could react as a level changed around them.

cards.heading: A Pipe Can Stop Being a Fixed Point
cards.text: A pipe that begins to move changes the route the player was about to take. Wonder Flowers can alter elements that usually provide stable landmarks, asking the player to observe their new behaviour and adjust the next jump. The character's familiar controls provide a reliable way to respond while the course transforms.

cards.heading: A Badge Changes How You Approach an Obstacle
cards.text: Players choose a badge before entering a level. Some modify movement; others provide assistance. The selection changes the tools available for a familiar obstacle and can encourage another attempt with a different approach. A badge becomes part of preparing for a course, allowing players to favour exploration, a new movement option or a greater margin of safety.

cards.heading: An Elephant Makes Transformation Physical
cards.text: Elephant form gives the character a larger body and a trunk, with collected water providing another action to use in the course. The transformation changes both the animation and the available moves. Familiar spaces take on a different comic scale, while opportunities to use the trunk and water let players experiment with the power-up.

cards.heading: Animation Makes Character Readable
cards.text: Character animation communicates running, braking and transformation while the player plans the next jump. Nintendo increased expressive detail while retaining clear silhouettes. The characters share many movement rules but have distinct visual identities, and their reactions help show how speed, terrain and a Wonder effect are affecting the action.

cards.heading: Playing Online Without Turning Everyone Into an Obstacle
cards.text: Online players appear as live player shadows and can leave standees to help others. Their presence offers support as people tackle the same course, with a nearby player or marker providing a possible rescue after a mistake. This allows strangers to share progress through a level while preserving each player's space to move.

cards.heading: Surprise Works Because the Controls Remain Familiar
cards.text: Wonder Flowers can bend pipes, change perspective and alter a course's rhythm. Each transformation introduces a playable situation that the player must read and complete. Familiar character controls carry across these changes, giving the player a way to test the new rules and bring that particular surprise to its conclusion.
